items.name: Halo
items.description: A glowing halo that floats above your head, with a soft shine around it.

items.name: Energy Shield
items.description: A turning bubble of glowing hex panels around you, with a shimmer that sweeps over it.

items.name: Star Orbit
items.description: Three glowing Stars of David orbit around you, leaving soft trails behind them.

items.name: Heart Orbit
items.description: Four puffy hearts float around you, bobbing and glowing.

items.name: Planet Rings
items.description: Two banded rings spin around you at different tilts, with a tiny moon riding along.

items.name: Leaf Swirl
items.description: A whirlwind of leaves spiralling round you, each one tumbling as it goes.

items.name: Spirit Flames
items.description: A ring of flickering ghost-fire around your feet, with embers drifting up.

items.name: Orbiting Blades
items.description: Three enchanted swords circle you, bobbing as they go.

items.name: Rune Circle
items.description: A turning circle of glowing runes under your feet, with rune stones floating around you.

items.name: Lmg Cape
items.description: The original - a glowing Star of David over LMG.

items.name: Aurora
items.description: Northern lights over snowy peaks.

items.name: Royal
items.description: Purple velvet, ermine collar and gold trim.

items.name: Void
items.description: A purple galaxy swirling into the dark.

items.name: Sunset
items.description: Synthwave sun over a neon grid.

items.name: Cherry Blossom
items.description: Pink blossoms under the moon.

items.name: Moonlit Sea
items.description: The moon shining on night waves.

items.name: Inferno
items.description: Flames licking up from the bottom, with floating embers.

items.name: Rainbow
items.description: Bright rainbow stripes with fluffy clouds.

items.name: Night Forest
items.description: Pine trees, a crescent moon and fireflies.

items.name: Racer
items.description: A checkered flag with a red racing stripe.

items.name: Thunderstorm
items.description: Rain sweeping down, rolling clouds and a lightning strike every couple of seconds.

items.name: Code Rain
items.description: Green code pouring down a black screen.

items.name: Hyperspace
items.description: Stars streaking past as you jump to light speed.

items.name: Koi Pond
items.description: Two koi swimming laps under lily pads, with ripples on the water.

items.name: Phoenix
items.description: A fire bird beating its wings over rising embers. Goes with the Phoenix Wings.

items.name: Cat Ears
items.description: Chunky cat ears with pink insides. They twitch every now and then.

items.name: Fox Ears
items.description: Tall fox ears with dark tips and fluffy white insides.

items.name: Bunny Ears
items.description: Tall soft bunny ears. One flops over and bounces when you move.

items.name: Bear Ears
items.description: Round fuzzy bear ears with soft insides. They wiggle a little.

items.name: Devil Horns
items.description: Ridged curved devil horns that fade to black at the tips. Goes with the Devil Tail.

items.name: Bug Antennae
items.description: Wobbly segmented antennae with glowing tips.

items.name: Elf Ears
items.description: Long pointed elf ears with a little gold cuff. Pick your skin colour.

items.name: Antlers
items.description: Branching deer antlers with a few tiny glowing mushrooms growing on them.

items.name: Axolotl Gills
items.description: Three frilly axolotl gills on each side of your head. They wave gently.

items.name: Aviators
items.description: Gold aviators with a double bridge. The colour sets the lens tint.

items.name: Pixel Shades
items.description: Deal with it. Now with a shine that sweeps across.

items.name: 3D Glasses
items.description: Retro cinema glasses: white card frame, red and cyan lenses.

items.name: Cyber Visor
items.description: A glowing wrap-around visor with a sweeping scan line and side emitters.

items.name: Heart Shades
items.description: Heart-shaped shades. The colour sets the frame and the lens tint.

items.name: Round Specs
items.description: Thin round wire glasses with clear lenses and little nose pads. Smart look.

items.name: Star Shades
items.description: Glowing star-shaped lenses with twinkling sparkles. They light up at night.

items.name: Snow Goggles
items.description: Big mirrored snow goggles on a thick strap. The colour sets the mirror.

items.name: Monocle
items.description: A gold monocle with a dangling chain that sways. Quite right.

items.name: Holo HUD
items.description: A side-mounted emitter that projects a holographic display over your right eye.

items.name: Royal Crown
items.description: A gold crown with fleur points, big gems and a velvet cap.

items.name: Top Hat
items.description: A tall classy top hat with a curled brim, a red band and a playing card tucked in.

items.name: China Hat
items.description: The classic see-through PvP cone, now with a woven rim. It spins slowly.

items.name: Beanie
items.description: Cosy knitted beanie with a folded cuff and a bouncy pom-pom.

items.name: Witch Hat
items.description: Wide wavy brim, crooked tip, orange band with a buckle and a little moon. The tip flops when you move.

items.name: Cowboy Hat
items.description: Curled brim, pinched crown, leather band with a silver concho. Yeehaw.

items.name: Party Hat
items.description: A tilted striped party cone with a fluffy pom-pom and a party horn noise you can only imagine.

items.name: Flower Crown
items.description: A braided vine of flowers and leaves. The colour picks the main flowers.

items.name: Frog Hat
items.description: A floppy green bucket hat with big frog eyes that blink, and little pink cheeks.

items.name: Headphones
items.description: Chunky over-ear headphones. The rings on the cups glow and pulse.

items.name: Star Crown
items.description: A ring of glowing stars that circles above your head on a thin halo.

items.name: Viking Helmet
items.description: Riveted steel helmet with a bronze band, nose guard and big curved horns.

items.name: Astronaut Helmet
items.description: A glass space helmet with a padded collar and a blinking antenna.

items.name: Pirate Tricorn
items.description: A three-cornered captain's hat with gold trim, a skull badge and a red plume.

items.name: Cat Tail
items.description: A long, thick cat tail that curls up into a hook and swishes as you move.

items.name: Fox Tail
items.description: One huge fluffy fox tail with a white tip. Goes with Fox Ears.

items.name: Bunny Tail
items.description: A big fluffy cotton puff that wiggles now and then.

items.name: Devil Tail
items.description: A thin, twitchy whip of a tail with a sharp spade on the end. Goes with Devil Horns.

items.name: Dragon Tail
items.description: A heavy scaled tail with bone spikes down its back and a fin on the tip. It drags low and sways slowly.

items.name: Robo Tail
items.description: Steel links joined by glowing rings, ending in a little claw with a blinking light.

items.name: Kitsune Tails
items.description: Three huge fluffy fox-spirit tails fanned out behind you, with white tips.

items.name: Scorpion Tail
items.description: An armoured scorpion tail that arches over your head, with a glowing venom stinger.

items.name: Angel Wings
items.description: Big layered feather wings that fold at the wrist when they flap, with a soft glow on the tips.

items.name: Demon Wings
items.description: Bat-style wings with dark bones, hooked claws and a see-through stretched membrane.

items.name: Butterfly Wings
items.description: Fluttering patterned wings on a fuzzy little body with curly antennae - pick any colour.

items.name: Neon Wings
items.description: Blades of pure light with bright cores and soft halos. They glow in the dark.

items.name: Fairy Wings
items.description: See-through shimmering wings with glowing veins and drifting sparkles. They flutter fast.

items.name: Dragon Wings
items.description: Huge scaled dragon wings with bone spikes and slow, heavy flaps. Goes with the Dragon Tail.

items.name: Crystal Wings
items.description: Floating glowing crystal shards in the shape of wings. Each one drifts on its own.

items.name: Phoenix Wings
items.description: Layered fire feathers with glowing tips. Big slow flaps that speed up when you run.

items.name: Mech Wings
items.description: Armoured jet wings on a back-mounted reactor. The thrusters flicker and the lights take your colour.
